# run
# note a file with nothing to report names itself not at all
>>> a.rr
-- a --
GET {{url}}/ HTTP/1.1

>>> b.rr
-- b --
GET {{url}}/ HTTP/1.1

>>> want a.rr
-- a --
GET {{url}}/ HTTP/1.1

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 1
Content-Type: text/plain

a
>>> want b.rr
-- b --
GET {{url}}/ HTTP/1.1

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 1
Content-Type: text/plain

b
>>> stdout
{{root}}/a.rr
-- a --
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 1
Content-Type: text/plain

a
{{root}}/b.rr
-- b --
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 1
Content-Type: text/plain

b
